# Synchronize Jupyter and Quarto Notebooks
Ensure all notebooks are synchronized with the latest updates.

```{python}
from helpers import sync_jupyter_and_quarto_in_folder
sync_jupyter_and_quarto_in_folder(".")
sync_jupyter_and_quarto_in_folder(r"..\docs\tutorials")
```

# Clean Jupyter Notebooks
Clean jupyter notebooks for version control.

```{python}
from helpers import clean_notebooks_in_folder

clean_notebooks_in_folder("..//docs//tutorials")
clean_notebooks_in_folder(".", skip=["git_merge_branch.ipynb"])
```

# Merge Branch
Merge a branch into the current branch.
**Make sure to manually solve all merge conflicts.**

```{python}
from helpers import merge_remote_branch

merge_remote_branch(remote="origin", branch="main")
```

# Synchronize Jupyter and Quarto Notebooks
After solving possible merge conflicts, all notebooks are again synchronized with the latest updates.

```{python}
from helpers import sync_jupyter_and_quarto_in_folder

sync_jupyter_and_quarto_in_folder(".")
sync_jupyter_and_quarto_in_folder(r"..\docs\tutorials")
```
